verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas ships official CLIs — `create-playcanvas` for scaffolding Engine/React/Web Component projects and `@playcanvas/splat-transform` for splat processing — and new projects created via the CLI include 'PlayCanvas Skills' that give AI coding agents PlayCanvas-specific workflows, directly supporting AI-native usage. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the CLI's AI-agent workflow support and more detail on agent-specific CLI flags or automation beyond scaffolding.
